# Vanguard Standing Orders
These are the orders the [color=purple]Grand Vizier[/color] holds the [color=tan]Vanguard[/color] to while the Sultanate's ceasefire with the Federation stands. Breaking them is answered by your superiors, in whatever manner the Vizier sees fit.
[color=red]OOC Note: These orders are In Character only. Admins act on the server rules, not on this page. You may follow or disobey them of your own free will, but you may face IC punishments from your superiors.[/color]
## While the ceasefire holds (WAR LEVEL: COLD)
1. The Sultan chooses the hour of the war. A [color=orange]Rahkshan[/color] who starts it early has stolen that choice from him.
2. Keep clear of Federation ships. If one closes on you, hail it, name the distance you want and give it time to turn away. If it does not, withdraw and report it.
3. Fire only when fired upon, when boarded, or when a warned ship will not leave the space around Helios or the Jupiter. End it when they break off.
4. The [color=tan]Vanguard[/color]'s work in this season is quiet: dead drops, supply crates, friends bought among the civilians, and eyes on Halcyon. A [color=red]Spasaka[/color] who is never seen has served perfectly.
5. If the Federation takes one of ours, tell the [color=yellow]Asvaran[/color] and the [color=purple]Grand Vizier[/color]. Ransom, exchange and patience bring a soldier home. A raid on their outpost brings a war the Sultan did not ask for.
6. Do not prey on the civilians of the sector. They carry our crates and sell us our steel.
7. Heretics named by the Sultanate are a matter apart, and are hunted as before.
## When war is declared (WAR LEVEL: HOT)
1. The ceasefire is void. Federation ships and soldiers are yours to engage wherever you find them, and Halcyon may be struck.
2. Fight as the [color=tan]Vanguard[/color] fights: divide them, board them, and leave nothing they can repair.
3. If the [color=purple]Grand Vizier[/color] offers a ceasefire and the Federation takes it, the fighting stops when the announcement sounds. Break off and come home.
